GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (22 Oct 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1805)
APO 500
22 October 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Hoisting of National Flag
1. There is no objection to the display of the Japanese national flag on 3 November 1947 as requested by C.L.O. No. 8138(PH) dated 18 October 1947, subject as above.
2. Occupation troops will be informed in this matter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
